scope.gaaSource: ODV integrated-project-data.json · GAA rows classified Multi-purpose building

matching: GAA is the historical MPB line baseline. Contractor-attributed records form a cross-source union: unique exact title/year DIME matches enrich GAA lines; DIME records without a unique GAA match are retained and flagged; awarded PhilGEPS MPB records are deduplicated and retained, with exact GAA title/year matches enriching a GAA row and unmatched awards flagged. Exact contractor names are consolidated across source records after punctuation/case normalization. DIME and PhilGEPS amounts remain source-labelled; no fuzzy project or contractor identity is inferred.

sourceNotes.DIME: ODV cached DIME project records; all keyword-filtered MPB contractor records with named contractors are included, including those without a unique exact GAA title/year match.
sourceNotes.PhilGEPS: ODV PhilGEPS award records. Deduplicated awarded MPB rows are included as independent contractor projects when no exact GAA title/year match exists; exact matches enrich the GAA-linked project.
sourceNotes.AMO: ODV PhilGEPS/AMO relationship cache. A name match is a lead for review, not proof of ownership, control, benefit, influence, or wrongdoing.
sourceNotes.PhilGEPS registration: ODV merchant-info cache. Status is Red or Platinum as captured by the source, not a live validity check. The cached merchant records were scraped in November 2025.
sourceNotes.PCAB: ODV PCAB regular-license CSV. Category, license number, government-infrastructure registration flag, and valid-through date are retained from the source. Exact normalized company-name match only.
